title: hydrocotyle ranunculoides var. genuina
intro: Hydrocotyle ranunculoides var. genuina, commonly known as Indian pennywort or gotu kola, is a plant native to Asia and Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing stress, anxiety, and inflammation, as well as promoting wound healing and improving cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Indian pennywort include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents are believed to possess antioxidant, anti-allergic, and immunomodulatory activities, contributing to its overall therapeutic potential.
